# up gofumpt to v0.3.0

Pin `gofumpt` at v0.3.0 in the Go toolset. `gofumpt` is a stricter drop-in for `gofmt` used on the author's Go code; the tools are installed by `go generate` over [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) from the versions pinned in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), so the upgrade is a change of that pin. The release notes are the [v0.3.0 tag](https://github.com/mvdan/gofumpt/releases/tag/v0.3.0).
